entries.title: Job 34:1
segments: ¶Furthermore Elihu answered and said,

entries.title: Job 34:2
segments: Hear my words, O ye wise [men]; and give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.

words.text: unto me, ye that have knowledge

entries.title: Job 34:3
segments: For the ear trieth words, as the mouth tasteth meat. {mouth: Heb. palate}

entries.title: Job 34:4
segments: Let us choose to us judgment: let us know among ourselves what [is] good.

entries.title: Job 34:5
segments: For Job hath said, I am righteous: and God hath taken away my judgment.

entries.title: Job 34:6
segments: Should I lie against my right? my wound [is] incurable without transgression. {my wound: Heb. mine arrow}

entries.title: Job 34:7
segments: What man [is] like Job, [who] drinketh up scorning like water?

entries.title: Job 34:8
segments: Which goeth in company with the workers of iniquity, and walketh with wicked men.

entries.title: Job 34:9
segments: For he hath said, It profiteth a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.

entries.title: Job 34:10
segments: ¶Therefore hearken unto me, ye men of understanding: far be it from God, [that he should do] wickedness; and [from] the Almighty, [that he should commit] iniquity. {men...: Heb. men of heart}

entries.title: Job 34:11
segments: For the work of a man shall he render unto him, and cause every man to find according to [his] ways.

words.text: unto him, and cause every man

entries.title: Job 34:12
segments: Yea, surely God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert judgment.

entries.title: Job 34:13
segments: Who hath given him a charge over the earth? or who hath disposed the whole world? {the whole: Heb. all of it?}

words.text: Who hath given him a charge

entries.title: Job 34:14
segments: If he set his heart upon man, [if] he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath; {man: Heb. him}

entries.title: Job 34:15
segments: All flesh shall perish together, and man shall turn again unto dust.

entries.title: Job 34:16
segments: ¶If now [thou hast] understanding, hear this: hearken to the voice of my words.

entries.title: Job 34:17
segments: Shall even he that hateth right govern? and wilt thou condemn him that is most just? {govern: Heb. bind?}

entries.title: Job 34:18
segments: [Is it fit] to say to a king, [Thou art] wicked? [and] to princes, [Ye are] ungodly?

entries.title: Job 34:19
segments: [How much less to him] that accepteth not the persons of princes, nor regardeth the rich more than the poor? for they all [are] the work of his hands.

words.text: [How much less to him] that accepteth

entries.title: Job 34:20
segments: In a moment shall they die, and the people shall be troubled at midnight, and pass away: and the mighty shall be taken away without hand. {the mighty...: Heb. they shall take away the mighty}

words.text: . {the mighty...: Heb. they shall take away the mighty}

entries.title: Job 34:21
segments: For his eyes [are] upon the ways of man, and he seeth all his goings.

entries.title: Job 34:22
segments: [There is] no darkness, nor shadow of death, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

entries.title: Job 34:23
segments: For he will not lay upon man more [than right]; that he should enter into judgment with God. {enter: Heb. go}

words.text: more [than right]; that he should enter

entries.title: Job 34:24
segments: He shall break in pieces mighty men without number, and set others in their stead. {number: Heb. searching out}

words.text: in their stead. {number: Heb. searching out}

entries.title: Job 34:25
segments: Therefore he knoweth their works, and he overturneth [them] in the night, so that they are destroyed. {destroyed: Heb. crushed}

entries.title: Job 34:26
segments: He striketh them as wicked men in the open sight of others; {open...: Heb. place of beholders}

words.text: of others; {open...: Heb. place of beholders}

entries.title: Job 34:27
segments: Because they turned back from him, and would not consider any of his ways: {him: Heb. after him}

entries.title: Job 34:28
segments: So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him, and he heareth the cry of the afflicted.

words.text: So that they cause the cry

entries.title: Job 34:29
segments: When he giveth quietness, who then can make trouble? and when he hideth [his] face, who then can behold him? whether [it be done] against a nation, or against a man only:

words.text: him? whether [it be done] against a nation

entries.title: Job 34:30
segments: That the hypocrite reign not, lest the people be ensnared.

entries.title: Job 34:31
segments: ¶Surely it is meet to be said unto God, I have borne [chastisement], I will not offend [any more]:

words.text: ¶Surely it is meet to be said

entries.title: Job 34:32
segments: [That which] I see not teach thou me: if I have done iniquity, I will do no more.

words.text: thou me: if I have done

entries.title: Job 34:33
segments: [Should it be] according to thy mind? he will recompense it, whether thou refuse, or whether thou choose; and not I: therefore speak what thou knowest. {according...: Heb. from with thee?}

words.text: [Should it be] according to thy mind? he will recompense

entries.title: Job 34:34
segments: Let men of understanding tell me, and let a wise man hearken unto me. {of...: Heb. of heart}

entries.title: Job 34:35
segments: Job hath spoken without knowledge, and his words [were] without wisdom.

entries.title: Job 34:36
segments: My desire [is that] Job may be tried unto the end because of [his] answers for wicked men. {My...: or, My father, let Job be tried}

words.text: . {My...: or, My father, let Job be tried}

entries.title: Job 34:37
segments: For he addeth rebellion unto his sin, he clappeth [his hands] among us, and multiplieth his words against God.
